period_note: Balance sheet and income-statement items come from a SINGLE unlabelled 'BALANCE SHEET (UN-AUDITED)' / 'PROFIT AND LOSS ACCOUNT (UN-AUDITED)' statement with no 'Consolidated' or 'Solo' qualifier anywhere in the heading -- this predates SIBL's later practice (from 2013 Q1 onward) of presenting a distinct Consolidated statement, and further predates its later practice (from 2016 Q2 onward) of ALSO presenting a separate Solo statement alongside it. SIBL's two subsidiaries (SIBL Securities Limited, SIBL Investment Limited) had themselves only just begun commercial operations in this same year (January 2012, per their own later annual-report disclosures), so the practical Solo-vs-Consolidated difference for this specific quarter is likely small; basis recorded as 'unlabeled' rather than confidently asserted as either. This is the EARLIEST surviving quarterly filing on SIBL's own site -- no Q1 2012 filing exists there; the site's quarterly/half-yearly archive begins at H1 2012.  Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2012 (Jan-1 through the end of this quarter), not discrete-quarter figures, per this project's convention (flagged via the _cumulative suffix, matching bank_financials/CITYBANK/quarterly/2024_Q1.json). Shariah-based Islamic bank: 'Investments' is the Shariah-compliant equivalent of conventional Loans and Advances; 'Profit paid on Deposits' is the equivalent of Interest Expense; 'Net Investment Income' is the equivalent of Net Interest Income -- consistent with the convention already used for this bank's Q4/annual series. Classified-investment (asset-quality/NPL) and Capital Adequacy (CRAR/Tier-1/Tier-2) figures are NOT disclosed in SIBL's interim quarterly/half-yearly filings at all (confirmed absent from every quarter's notes checked in this pass) -- this is a genuine limitation of the source documents themselves, not an extraction gap, so no classified_investments/npl_pct/car_pct/tier1/tier2/RWA fields are populated for any Q1-Q3 period in this dataset.
